note: Reconstitution of Strabane rural district council after the commissioners. Nominations were lodged in April 1924 and, no withdrawals having been received, the deputy returning officer, Mr. W. R. Ingram, declared the following twenty-one candidates elected on 26 April 1924; all represented the Unionists (Belfast News-Letter, 28 April 1924). No poll was necessary. Declared elected without a contest (Unionist). Returned unopposed.
